About Ella

Art has been part of my life for as long as I can remember. When I was 12, I started working seriously on my skills, and I haven’t stopped since.

In high school I took several advanced drawing classes, then AP Drawing, where my portfolio earned a 5. Today I’m a student at UVA studying engineering, hoping to add a minor in art, and growing Art With Ella on the side.

Every print and commission is made with the same care I put into my first drawings.

Prints

Every piece is printed to order as an art paper print, a canvas, or a framed print. Pick a type and size to see the price and how the print crops the artwork, then check out securely with Stripe. Your order is printed and shipped straight to you.

If a crop would cut off something important, email me before you order and I’ll make a custom crop. Looking for an original? I also sell small canvases starting at $60 (5×7). Ask what’s available.

Order a print

Choose your piece, print type and size, then continue to secure payment with Stripe. You’ll enter your shipping address there. Prints are made to order and shipped to you (US only for now).

    Payment is handled by Stripe, so I never see your card details. Orders go to print right after payment, so email me first if you need a custom crop or size.

    Commissions

    Want something made just for you? A portrait, a pet, a gift, a wall that needs a painting. Tell me about it.

    1. Send the form with your idea, size, and deadline.
    2. I reply with a quote and a timeline.
    3. I share sketches, you approve, and I paint.
